_comment: Systematics-grade minimal_rho production on the 2026-08-06 pair_split fiducial (the processor default since 5f098fb: >=3 jets, |y| < 2.4 on the three leading, pT > 200/200/185, dphimin > 1.0, dphi12 < pi - 200/ptavg -- the exact complement of the dijet cut). Same rho axis as trijet_mg_pythia8_2018_minimal_rho.json; the changes are the selection and all_syst instead of minimal_syst. all_syst passes systematics=None so every weights_obj variation is filled (pu, l1prefiring, Luminosity, and pdf/Q2muF/Q2muR/isr/fsr on the madgraphMLM samples) rather than nominal only. all_syst also runs the full 61-entry jet-systematic set (nominal + JER/JMS/JMR up/down + both directions of all 27 split JES sources), matching zjet_processor -- the hadronic None-default used to stop at JER/JMS/JMR, which left a hadronic all_syst run silently JES-free. Measured cost of the JES loop on a local chunk: 2.8x wall time. Also carries the per-jet kinematic validation hists (pt/eta/phi/mass/msoftdrop for jet3) across the full systematic axis. QCD madgraphMLM HT bins.
